events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches; sed -n 1,75p README.md; for f in tantra-frontend-v2/*.patch; do echo "== $f"; head -5 $f | grep -E '^(From |Subject)'; grep -c '^From [0-9a-f]\{40\}' $f; done
